aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.subtitle: Information about our site
aboutUs.text: Welcome to Black Circle - your ultimate destination for renting fashion items. Explore our extensive collection of clothing, shoes, and accessories available for rent from top vendors. Our platform allows you to browse, select, and rent high-quality items effortlessly. Enjoy flexible rental periods, detailed descriptions, and high-resolution images to make informed decisions. Vendors, join us to reach a broader audience, increase your brand's visibility, and generate additional revenue by renting out your inventory. Embrace sustainable fashion and reduce waste by opting for rental options. Discover the perfect pieces for any occasion without the commitment of purchasing. Shop now and elevate your style with ease.

company.title: Company
company.subtitle: Information about our company
company.text: At Black Circle, we are committed to providing a seamless and sustainable rental experience for fashion enthusiasts. Our mission is to make high-quality fashion accessible to everyone while promoting eco-friendly practices. With a focus on customer satisfaction, we offer a diverse range of clothing, shoes, and accessories from renowned vendors. Join our community and enjoy the benefits of fashion without the long-term commitment.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Get in touch with us
contact.text: We're here to help! Whether you have questions about our services, need assistance with your rental, or want to provide feedback, our dedicated support team is ready to assist you. Reach out to us via email, phone, or our online contact form. We value your input and strive to provide prompt and helpful responses to all inquiries.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How can we assist you?
help.text: At Black Circle, we prioritize customer support and aim to make your rental experience as smooth as possible. Our Help section provides comprehensive guides and answers to common questions about our platform, rental process, and policies. If you need further assistance, our support team is always available to offer personalized help and ensure you have a seamless experience.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about Black Circle. Our FAQ section covers topics such as account setup, rental procedures, payment methods, shipping, and returns. We aim to address your concerns and provide detailed information to make your rental experience straightforward and enjoyable. If you can't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact our support team.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.subtitle: Shipping Information
shipping.text: Learn about our shipping policies and procedures at Black Circle. We offer reliable and timely shipping options to ensure your rented items arrive in perfect condition. Our shipping information section details our delivery methods, estimated delivery times, and shipping costs. We are committed to providing a hassle-free and efficient shipping experience for all our customers.

rent.title: Rent
rent.subtitle: How to Rent
rent.text: Renting from Black Circle is simple and convenient. Browse our extensive catalog of fashion items, select your desired products, and choose your rental period. Our platform provides clear pricing and rental terms, ensuring a transparent and user-friendly experience. Enjoy the flexibility of wearing high-quality fashion pieces without the commitment of buying. Embrace sustainable fashion with Black Circle today.
